+\"\"\"Automate release preparation.\"\"\"
+
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import re
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import typer
+
+app = typer.Typer()
+
+VERSION_FILE = Path(\"fastapi/__init__.py\")
+
+
+@app.command()
+def prepare(version: str = typer.Argument(..., help=\"The new version to set (e.g., 0.136.4)\")):
+    \"\"\"
+    Prepare a new release.
+    \"\"\"
+    # 1. Update version in fastapi/__init__.py
+    if not VERSION_FILE.exists():
+        print(f\"Error: {VERSION_FILE} not found\")
+        raise typer.Exit(code=1)
+
+    content = VERSION_FILE.read_text()
+    new_content = re.sub(r'__version__ = \".*\"', f'__version__ = \"{version}\"', content)
+    if content == new_content:
+        print(f\"Version {version} is already set in {VERSION_FILE}\")
+    else:
+        VERSION_FILE.write_text(new_content)
+        print(f\"Updated version to {version} in {VERSION_FILE}\")
+
+    # 2. Run add_latest_release_date.py
+    print(\"Running add_latest_release_date.py...\")
+    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, \"scripts/add_latest_release_date.py\"])
+    if result.returncode != 0:
+        print(\"Error running add_latest_release_date.py\")
+        raise typer.Exit(code=1)
+
+    print(\"Release preparation complete!\")
+
+
+if __name__ == \"__main__\":
+    app()
